scene: The capsule drops into your hands, stamped with three departure gates.
picture: Flat side-view slice along the tower transit deck. Left, a waiting glass-roofed trolley sits on rails. Center, the woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat holds the caught green capsule. Right, a suspended red mountain cable tram waits with door open. Far right, a green river barge floats docked by wooden bollards.
shown: a waiting glass-roofed trolley idling on tracks at the far left platform
a red mountain cable tram hanging stationary from cables on the right
a green river barge moored to a low dock at the far right
